name: agent-web-research
description: Lightweight web-research routing with Exa semantic retrieval and Context7 version-aware technical documentation lookup, designed around progressive-disclosure skills and CLI-based tools.

interface.shortDescription: Web research routing, Exa retrieval, and version-aware Context7 technical docs
interface.longDescription: Adds a lightweight web-research-router skill, Exa retrieval backed by Python CLI scripts with REST-first and anonymous Hosted-MCP fallback, plus a Context7 technical-documentation skill that uses the official ctx7 CLI for version-sensitive library, framework, SDK, API, CLI, configuration, and migration facts.
defaultPrompt: Use web-research-router when web-research routing is ambiguous or needs fallback.
Use Exa retrieval for long-tail semantic sources or when native web search is unavailable.
Use context7-tech-docs when third-party technical usage is version-sensitive or uncertain.
